scope: Three-project DOCX-to-Markdown comparison using an official English local-government template whose visible body is almost entirely DrawingML textboxes.

execution_contract.docwen_ref_tk_entry: Production convert_docx_to_md after gui_run.py translator injection.
execution_contract.docwen_current_entry: DocumentPlugin -> TaskManager -> OutputFinalizer with source-owned naming and yaml_key_labels.
invalid_harness_attempts_excluded: The first current result reader assumed artifact kind=markdown instead of the canonical primary kind plus text/markdown media type; conversion succeeded, but that harness result was deleted and rerun fresh.

pre_fix_current_regressions.description: Element deduplication retained id(lxml_wrapper) without retaining the wrapper; CPython reused ids and 17 distinct textbox paragraphs were silently skipped.
Raw w:t concatenation discarded w:br and joined two visible multiline textbox paragraphs.
joined_examples: What needs to be in place?(Enablers)

pre_fix_current_regressions.description: Exported textbox paragraphs did not contribute to ArtifactManifest paragraph_count.

evidence_backed_current_improvements: Current preserves all 21 unique Choice-branch textbox paragraphs; both old projects preserve 19 and omit What needs to be true? plus Coordinator.
Current keeps the unique textbox paragraphs in source XML order; both old projects reorder anchored textboxes.
Current finalizes a stable source-owned name with accurate 21-paragraph metadata and diagnostics.
shared_reference_limits: All three omit the ordinary footer texts Cambridge Rich Picture Facilitation, Workshop Templates and October 2023.
Markdown preserves textbox text semantics, not DrawingML geometry, grouping, colors, connector relationships or page layout.
The 15 drawings are WordprocessingShape textboxes with no word/media files, so zero image artifacts is correct.
accepted_limits: The official source URL, SHA-256, OOXML profile and normalized projection are checked in; the external DOCX binary is not redistributed.
Current additional source paragraphs and source-order preservation are evidence-backed improvements, not regressions against the old output byte stream.
remaining_scope: This is one English local-government template, not a broad DrawingML or business-document corpus.
The sample does not exercise raster/vector media, comments, revisions, fields, hyperlinks or tables.
Physical Word/WPS/LibreOffice rendering and visible shape-layout fidelity are not exercised.
Ordinary header/footer extraction remains a shared product limitation.
GOLDEN-002 and overall final artifact parity remain NOT PASSED YET.
